india_trends.title: ITAT: Accrued interest component on non-convertible debentures sales is taxable as interest income
india_trends.summary: The ITAT has held that the accrued interest component embedded in sale proceeds from non-convertible debentures cannot automatically be treated as capital gains and may instead be taxed as interest income. Tax experts say the decision could trigger greater scrutiny and fresh litigation.

Analysts attribute this slump to signals from the Federal Reserve and a notable downturn in technology stocks.
